主要内容: Geospace Technologies Corporation held a Special Meeting of Stockholders on August 20, 2013, at its headquarters in Houston, Texas. Shareholders voted on Proposal 1, which sought approval of an amendment to the Company's 1997 Key Employee Stock Option Plan. The proposal was approved with 10,827,317 votes in favor, 138,603 against, and 6,775 abstentions. The voting results confirmed the ratification of the grant of certain stock options under the 1997 Key Employee Stock Option Plan.
